[RFCS.6a.2] The `FactEmit` body is defined in `proto/fact_emit.proto`.
It carries the same fact-bearing fields as `FactAssert` ([RFCS.6.2]) and
one the integrator atom has no use for: `rule_name`, the emitting rule, which is
never empty on this atom. Field 9 is reserved and out of use.

`ttl_ns` carries the per-emit TTL override ([LDTL.4.1]). The override is
evaluated from an expression at emit time, so it is **not** recoverable
from the `.dsc` and a reader that does not carry it cannot reproduce the
fact deadline.
